entries.summary: BorrowAccountFactory deployed; its constructor deploys the bcBTC receipt and the BorrowAccount implementation.
entries.proves: The account factory, gated collateral receipt and clone implementation fit in one transaction under Mezo's 10M block gas limit.

entries.summary: M1 created on Mezo's official testnet Morpho Blue: MUSD loan, bcBTC collateral, BtcMusdOracle, AdaptiveCurveIrm, LLTV 0.77.
entries.proves: A redemption-free BTC→MUSD market now exists on Mezo's own Morpho deployment, created permissionlessly.

entries.summary: Team supplied 3,000 MUSD of liquidity to M1.
entries.proves: Judges can borrow immediately; in Wave 2 this liquidity moves into the vMUSD lending vault.

entries.summary: openAndBorrow: 0.001 BTC sent as msg.value, 30 MUSD borrowed in one transaction (0.1% origination fee).
entries.proves: One-transaction BTC→MUSD credit priced by the live Skip precompile, with no 2,000-MUSD minimum and no redemption queue.

entries.summary: repayAndWithdraw: debt repaid exactly by shares, collateral withdrawn and unwrapped to native BTC in one transaction.
entries.proves: The oracle-free exit path works on-chain; debt and collateral are both zero afterwards.

entries.summary: wsMUSD seeded with 1 MUSD of dead shares, deposited into the real sMUSD.
entries.proves: The ERC-4626 wrapper composes with Mezo's live claim-based sMUSD and is protected against first-depositor inflation.
